summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 6 upside misses — TSN +9%, CNC +5%, TSCO +4%, ELV +4%, LUV +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (SNDK -9%, LITE -8%, CIEN -8%, BE -8%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: TSN (+8.72%) — No confirmed same-day catalyst found; likely beef/protein-sector move tied to USDA Mexican cattle import reopening news (unverified date). Treat as no obvious news catalyst. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: TSN is a ~$22B mid/large-cap packaged-food/protein name, likely excluded by sector or cap filters. A news-driven +8.7% gap with no scheduled earnings also favours pre-market positioning.
